verdict.rationale: Direct probe evidence confirms llms.txt is live at https://docs.fireworks.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a documentation index, and per-page .md endpoints (e.g. introduction.md) explicitly point agents back to the llms.txt index, making the docs agent-consumable by design. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent successfully using this to complete a task end-to-end.
